summary: This experimental RFC describes a sender-side change to the TCP and SCTP retransmission timers that speeds up loss recovery when only a little data is in flight. RTO Restart lets the sender restart its timer so it fires sooner than the standard behavior would.

eli5.summary: If you have sent only one letter and it gets lost, waiting a long time to notice is silly. This makes the sender notice sooner and send it again.

questions: faster loss recovery with little data
